propositions: Operator-seeded SSM SecureString values persist in cleartext in remote terraform state (S3 bucket rebar-tfstate-896586841071) due to the value + ignore_changes pattern, collapsing the secret tier to state-bucket ACL
The current ignore_changes lifecycle block suppresses terraform diff but not refresh, causing the AWS provider to read live secret values into state on every plan/refresh/import

Three resources (rebar_secrets, opcert_ed25519_key, cookie_signing_secret) must migrate from value + ignore_changes to write-only arguments (value_wo + value_wo_version) which the provider never persists to state
Terraform and AWS provider version floors must be raised to >=1.11 and ~>5.79 respectively to support write-only arguments
A hermetic structural guard (check_ssm_secret_state.py) must prevent regression of any SecureString parameter declaring a literal value or ignore_changes block, wired into make lint
The one-time migration apply will reset already-seeded secrets to placeholder value; re-seeding and rotation must occur in the same maintenance window as the deferred operator task
